Package com.j3d.engine.scene.draw

Class RenderState<P extends Pure,O extends GObject>

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.scene.draw.RenderState<P,O>
Type Parameters:
P - The type of the pure geometric object, extending Pure.
O - The type of the graphical object, extending GObject.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Drawable
public class RenderState<P extends Pure,O extends GObject> extends Object implements Drawable
Represents the rendering state for a graphical object, linking a pure geometric definition with its graphical object representation. It manages drawing logic and selection state.
